commands: RUNID="${GITHUB_RUN_ID:-local-$(date -u +%Y%m%dT%H%M%SZ)}-${GITHUB_RUN_ATTEMPT:-1}"; echo "run-id=$RUNID"; mkdir -p ".prflow/tmp/review/pr-1736/$RUNID"; gh pr diff 1736 | awk '/^diff --git/{in_logs=/ [ab]\/\.prflow\/logs\//} !in_logs' | tee ".prflow/tmp/review/pr-1736/$RUNID/diff.patch" | grep -c '^diff --git'

cd /home/runner/work/prflow/prflow; H=00ff94629d67ea3048224fbcf856816ab5b8bfba
echo "=== references dir at HEAD ==="; git ls-tree --name-only $H skills/implement/references/ | grep sweep
echo "=== Procedure pointers in phase files at HEAD ==="; git show $H:skills/implement/phases/phase-2-sweeps-contract.md | grep -n '^\*\*Procedure:\*\*'
git show $H:skills/implement/phases/phase-2-sweeps-quality.md | grep -n '^\*\*Procedure:\*\*'

H=00ff94629d67ea3048224fbcf856816ab5b8bfba; export H
git ls-tree --name-only "$H" skills/implement/references/ | grep sweep
echo "=== contract procedure pointers ==="
git show "$H":skills/implement/phases/phase-2-sweeps-contract.md | grep -n 'Procedure:'
echo "=== quality procedure pointers ==="
git show "$H":skills/implement/phases/phase-2-sweeps-quality.md | grep -n 'Procedure:'
